dataPolicy: Original editable SI definitions; no paper software, weights or datasets are redistributed. FEM fields are evaluation references, never training labels.

cases.scope: Independent axial analytical patch baseline for the reusable potential-energy/exact-boundary method; not a paper experiment replication.
deviations: Dense autograd displacement network and composite mesh quadrature instead of tensor decomposition and meshless finite differences.
CPU float64 Adam baseline; no original GPU speedup claim.
cases.comparisonPolicy: Identical FEM nodes/cell centroids; unweighted relative L2 and maximum errors. Separate continuum patch and conservation checks live in test_energy_pinn.py.
cases.meshPolicy: Use editable project settings, then vary mesh/quadrature independently from optimization.
cases.acceptance: Independent two-seed concave axial tests require <3% displacement, energy and balance errors, <5% stress. This runner records example measurements without replacing those gates.
cases.failurePolicy: Reject invalid/nonfinite inputs, incompatible supports, cancelled execution and invalid caches; retain integration/residual/balance warnings.

cases.scope: Wang et al. (2023), Section 3.2 boundary pattern: fixed bottom, ux=0 and uy=0.1 on only the left half of a square top edge.
deviations: Small-strain adaptation; the original reference enabled large displacement.
1 m and 10 MPa SI conventions follow https://doi.org/10.1111/mice.13292 Section 3.2; thickness 0.01 m is a Phyra choice.
Dense autograd network, triangle/boundary-chord composite quadrature, Adam and CPU float64 replace original architecture, derivatives and runtime.
Prescribed displacement is 10% of side length: linear mathematical comparison, not physical large-deformation validation.
cases.reference: Ordinary plane-stress FEM on the same physical definition; no digitized paper field or paper accuracy/speed claim.
cases.comparisonPolicy: Same-location FEM displacement/stress differences, force/moment balance, exact driven/free-half tests and finer independent integration audit. Mixed-boundary endpoint stress is not a smooth reference.
cases.meshPolicy: Editable five-edge profile; refine mesh and quadrature separately, and report both method costs.
cases.acceptance: Runnable research case with reported errors and warnings; no fixed field-accuracy guarantee. Exact partial-segment boundary enforcement and unchanged input ownership are regression gates.
cases.failurePolicy: Curved essential supports, interior non-supporting lines and incompatible prescribed intersections are explicitly unsupported.

cases.scope: Changed-geometry energy case reusing the second-quadrant circular-cutout SI project, exact Kirsch outer traction and symmetry supports.
deviations: Generic potential-energy method; not the original normalized EPINN implementation or a performance replication.
Source units/thickness are unspecified; numerical m/Pa realization and 0.1 m thickness are Phyra choices.
Exact CAD arc is discretized with mesh chords; curved natural boundaries are supported, curved essential supports are rejected.
cases.reference: Ordinary FEM plus matching Kirsch analytical displacement/stress reference through a separate solve; analytical field assumes an infinite plate with exact outer traction.
cases.comparisonPolicy: Same-location FEM/PINN fields and balance plus independent finer integration audit. Mesh/quadrature/optimization errors remain separate.
cases.meshPolicy: Refine target and boundary sizes and change radius/load explicitly; preserve reference eligibility.
cases.acceptance: Runnable research case with measured errors and warnings, not a field-accuracy guarantee. Existing independent three-resolution Kirsch FEM gates remain unchanged.
cases.failurePolicy: Mismatch between radius, symmetry, geometry and traction removes analytical reference eligibility; invalid geometry and cancellation cannot publish fields.
